description: This file defines an enum CustomDateTimeProvider that implements the DateTimeProvider interface from Spring Data. It provides methods to retrieve the current date and time in different formats (local system time or UTC) for auditing purposes within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: CustomDateTimeProvider
classes.description: An enum implementing DateTimeProvider to supply current date/time in different modes for auditing.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current date/time as an Optional<TemporalAccessor>, either local system time or UTC based on the enum instance.
